original_test_intent: Verify the SMBIOS Type 2 BaseBoard Manufacturer exactly identifies the approved board vendor—not the Type 1 system brand—and persists after reboot.
original_method: Collect full Type 2, select the intended baseboard structure when multiple boards exist, correlate Manufacturer with board product/serial/location and BOM, compare to the board recipe, reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves board identity/mapping and plan. Type 2 collection, board selection and comparison are automatable.
safety_requirements: Preserve all Type 2 structures and errors; do not assume the first board is the target.
Do not substitute Type 1 Manufacturer or BMC/card vendor.
Stop on ambiguous board selection, BOM mismatch, drift or reboot failure.
agent_execution_scope: Collect all Type 2/tool/BOM identity, identify the intended baseboard record and compare Manufacturer before/after reboot.
Do not modify DMI, guess board selection or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve board record/BOM mapping and expected vendor/branding semantics.
Resolve ODM/OEM identity differences and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: dmidecode -t 2 is correct, but grep can collapse multiple boards and lacks full identity context; hidden errors/insecure transport are rejected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete sudo dmidecode -t 2 and tool version/errors using approved transport; select target by correlated Type 2 fields before extracting Manufacturer.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 2 script, baseboard Manufacturer scope and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Enumerate every Type 2 record, map target by product/serial/location/BOM and compare its Manufacturer separately from system branding across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 2 systems, including multiple baseboard records.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode, BIOS and BOM revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Approved baseboard/BOM identity recipe and installed dmidecode documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds multi-record selection and board/system identity separation.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Board record mapping and expected vendor.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OEM branding can intentionally differ from physical ODM; the project recipe determines expected Type 2 content.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve an OEM or ODM board-vendor string for a named board revision, but must identify the specific Type 2 record/BOM.
expected_evidence: Approval, expected board vendor, BOM/record mapping and tool version
Raw pre-reboot all-Type-2 records plus target selection
